Now I have a thorough understanding of all the fs usage. Let me now make the targeted changes. The request-path files that need `// TODO(cloudflare):` comments are:

**Routes:**
1. `routes/access.ts` - reads bundled SKILL.md files from disk (Pattern C)
2. `routes/adapters.ts` - reads package.json from npm install dir (Pattern C)
3. `routes/plugins.ts` - existsSync for dev-only bundled examples (Pattern C)
4. `routes/plugin-ui-static.ts` - serves plugin UI bundles via local disk (Pattern C)

**Services:**
5. `services/agent-instructions.ts` - reads/writes instruction files from disk (Pattern A/B - local filesystem abstraction, complex)
6. `services/default-agent-instructions.ts` - reads bundled onboarding assets (Pattern C)
7. `services/heartbeat.ts` - mkdir/stat for workspace directories (local execution, Pattern C)
8. `services/company-skills.ts` - reads/writes skill markdown files on disk (Pattern A/B, complex)
9. `services/feedback.ts` - reads adapter trace files from disk (Pattern B/C)
10. `services/run-log-store.ts` - local file-backed run log store (Pattern A/B, entire store is disk-specific)
11. `services/workspace-operation-log-store.ts` - local file-backed op log store (Pattern A/B, entire store is disk-specific)
12. `services/plugin-database.ts` - reads SQL migration files from plugin package (Pattern C)
13. `services/adapter-plugin-store.ts` - reads/writes adapter plugin registry JSON (Pattern A/B)
14. `services/local-service-supervisor.ts` - reads/writes service registry on disk (Pattern A/B)
15. `services/execution-workspaces.ts` - `fs.access` call on workspace path (Pattern C)

**Middleware:**
16. `middleware/logger.ts` - mkdirSync at module load (boot-time, safe)
